subject: TEST REQUESTS from audit: frontend wire assembly is context-only in the 610/610 report
body: report.json lists runtime_pipeline.inc and compute_frontend.m as context_sources: the 610 checks never execute tegu_runtime_dispatch_v2 / tegu_compute_encoder_dispatch. Both compute blockers (v2Buffers[8] indexed by Metal slot; TDG2 sent for TGP1 variants) live in that unexecuted code. integration_tests: please add (never weaken existing) (a) a host build of the real frontend with the NATIVE macro set (-DTEGU_AIR_BRIDGE -DTEGU_MALI_BRIDGE -DTEGU_GRAPHICS_BRIDGE -DNORD2_JM_TRANSPORT, as in tools/build_tegu_frontend_objects.sh) driving a function-created buffer-only kernel through the real n2mb bridge fake kernel (expect one submit and the same bytes as the TDG1 path); check_runtime_v1_aligned.py/runtime_frontend_host_test.m omit TEGU_GRAPHICS_BRIDGE so they compile the legacy dispatcher; (b) a kernel whose buffers sit at Metal slots 9 and 30 with a texture at slot 1/22: assert every referenced object retained exactly once (CFGetRetainCount-style counters) and released at command dealloc; (c) ASan 2-thread test: thread A grows TeguRenderPipeline.genericVariants 4->5 (render_pipeline.inc:513-519 malloc/memcpy/free) while thread B reads genericVariants[0] as tegu_generic_draw_submit does at execute time (compositor_submit.inc:241); (d) compute kernel sampling/writing a texture that has shadowSurface (BGRA8 IOSurface fallback): assert tegu_shadow_sync_jobs sees it (it only scans compositorTextures/renderTexture, compute_frontend.m:323 v2Textures are never scanned). My probes: gpu/build/claude-audit-20261025/{tgp1_tdg2_probe.c,v2buffers_alias_probe.m}. Source hashes: runtime_pipeline.inc cad3849b, compute_frontend.m 2b1076be, render_encoder.inc 6b1277a6, compositor_submit.inc ecd96c7a, render_pipeline.inc cf3e8d05 (changed to 46f41ec3 at 19:42, re-check lines).
